children: Dar Al Majed Real Estate Company (Al Majdiah) has signed an agreement with Jadwa Al Maqar Real Estate Fund to develop nearly 300 residential units in Madinah.
The contract, which includes building 66 villas and 230 apartments, is valued at 185 million Saudi riyals ($49.31 million), the company said in a statement to the Saudi stock exchange.
Jadwa Al Maqar Real Estate Fund is managed by Masaken Noura Real Estate Company.
Work will be completed within 24 months from the date the agreement is signed, the statement said.
